title: TinyInfo
description: Adds a HUD overlay showing the age and growth status of baby mobs when looking at them.
body: # TinyInfo Displays growth status of baby mobs directly in the **F3 debug screen**, including whether they're locked by a **Golden Dandelion**. ### Activation Press **F3 + F6** to open the debug screen settings, search for `tinyinfo:looking_at_entity_age` and set it to **In Overlay** or **Always On**.
